sub_graphs.title: Electra Validator: Attestation Lifecycle with EIP-7549
sub_graphs.description: Models the modified attestation creation and aggregation flow under EIP-7549 committee-based aggregation

nodes.label: Validator Assigned to Committee
nodes.description: Validator has been assigned to a beacon committee for the current slot

nodes.label: Construct Attestation with Index Zero
nodes.description: Create attestation with attestation_data.index = 0 (EIP-7549 change from previous committee index)

nodes.label: Individual Attestation Created
nodes.description: Single validator attestation ready with committee_bits bitvector instead of single committee index

nodes.label: Compute On-Chain Aggregate
nodes.description: Combine disjoint committee_bits from attestations with equal AttestationData via compute_on_chain_aggregate()

nodes.label: Aggregated Attestation Ready
nodes.description: Multi-committee aggregate attestation ready for inclusion with MAX_ATTESTATIONS_ELECTRA limit

nodes.label: Include Attestation in Block
nodes.description: Block proposer includes aggregated attestations up to MAX_ATTESTATIONS_ELECTRA

edges.label: Validator constructs attestation for assigned slot
Attestation created with index=0 and committee_bits
Proposer selects aggregates for block inclusion

sub_graphs.title: Electra Validator: Deposit Handling with EIP-6110
sub_graphs.description: Models the new deposit processing logic that transitions from eth1 polling to execution layer deposit requests

nodes.label: Pending Deposits in Queue
nodes.description: Deposits waiting to be processed, tracked by deposit_requests_start_index

nodes.label: Calculate Pending Deposit Count
nodes.description: Execute get_eth1_pending_deposit_count() to determine how many deposits to include based on deposit_requests_start_index

nodes.label: Deposit Count Determined
nodes.description: Number of deposits to include in block has been calculated

nodes.label: Include Deposits in Block
nodes.description: Block proposer includes calculated number of deposits in the block body

nodes.label: Eth1 Polling No Longer Required
nodes.description: Once transition period completes, eth1 data polling is no longer needed for deposits

external_entities.name: Execution Layer
external_entities.description: Execution layer providing deposit requests via EIP-6110 mechanism

sub_graphs.title: Electra Validator: Execution Request Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models the security boundary for execution requests (deposits, withdrawals, consolidations) entering the consensus layer

nodes.label: Execution Payload with Requests Received
nodes.description: GetPayloadResponse contains execution_requests: Sequence[bytes] from execution layer

nodes.label: Deserialize Execution Requests
nodes.description: Parse three request types: deposit requests, withdrawal requests, consolidation requests

nodes.label: Validate Request Type Ordering
nodes.description: Verify requests are in ascending order by type with no duplicate types

nodes.label: Enforce Per-Payload Request Limits
nodes.description: Validate that each request type does not exceed its maximum per-payload limit

nodes.label: Execution Requests Validated
nodes.description: All execution requests have passed deserialization, ordering, and limit checks

nodes.label: Execution Requests Rejected
nodes.description: Requests failed validation due to ordering, format, or limit violations

edges.label: Execution engine returns payload with requests
Parse request bytes into typed requests

external_entities.name: Execution Engine
external_entities.description: Execution layer engine providing payload with execution requests via engine API

sub_graphs.title: Electra Validator: Blob Sidecar Subnet Assignment (EIP-7691)
sub_graphs.description: Models the modified blob sidecar subnet routing using BLOB_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT_ELECTRA

nodes.label: Blob Sidecar Ready for Distribution
nodes.description: Blob sidecar constructed and ready to be published to appropriate subnet

nodes.label: Compute Subnet ID for Blob
nodes.description: Calculate subnet as blob_index % BLOB_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT_ELECTRA

nodes.label: Blob Sidecar Published to Subnet
nodes.description: Blob sidecar distributed to the correct subnet topic

ambiguities.text: Network attestation aggregates contain only the assigned committee attestations - unclear if this means strict filtering or if other committee attestations are silently dropped
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume strict filtering: aggregators only aggregate attestations from their assigned committee. Other committee attestations are handled by their respective aggregators.

ambiguities.text: The transition period for EIP-6110 deposit handling is referenced but the exact conditions for when eth1 polling is fully eliminated are not specified in this document
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the transition completes when deposit_requests_start_index catches up to the total deposit count. This needs cross-reference with the beacon chain spec.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution engine returns correctly ordered and properly formatted execution requests
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A malicious or buggy execution engine could inject invalid requests, potentially causing consensus failures or validator slashing

implicit_assumptions.description: All validators in the network upgrade to Electra simultaneously at ELECTRA_FORK_EPOCH and use the new attestation format
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Mixed network with old and new attestation formats could cause aggregation failures and reduced participation rates

implicit_assumptions.description: BLOB_SIDECAR_SUBNET_COUNT_ELECTRA is chosen to provide adequate distribution without overloading individual subnets
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Insufficient subnet count could lead to network congestion; excessive count could fragment blob availability
